literature.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: RSV 疫苗 有效但成本高昂,并且许可后研究表明吉兰-巴利综合征 (GBS) 的风险增加。审查得出的结论是,与 疫苗 相关的 GBS 相比,RSV 疫苗接种 可以避免更多来自 RSV 的质量调整生命年 (QALY)。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129023]
共有 54 名儿童参与(RSV:22,hMPV:32;男性:31,女性:23;中位年龄:3 岁,范围:11 个月至 11 岁)。随访1~3个月未发现交叉感染。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10342440/v1]
RSV 疫苗 已开发并获得 FDA 批准,其中 Arexvy、Abrysvo 和 mRESVIA 是著名的例子。尼塞韦单抗 和 Clesrovimab 等单克隆抗体也用于预防婴儿严重 RSV 疾病。 [10.1186/s40794-026-00313-3]

在 75% 的覆盖率下,疫苗接种 与 aRSVPreF3 预计将在 5 年内分别预防老年人和高危人群中 1,253,641 例和 1,083,247 例 RSV-ARI 病例,以及 552,517 例和 579,008 例 RSV-LRTD 病例。这些群体的直接医疗费用分别减少了 240,849,821 欧元和 331,050,265 欧元。疫苗接种 还避免了 58,129 和 102,786 例质量调整生命年损失,每增加 QALY,成本效益比分别为 13,832 欧元和 4,529 欧元。 [10.1007/s10198-026-01968-7]
审查报告称,成人 RSV 疫苗接种 可以减少高危人群的疾病、并发症和住院治疗,并指出两种 疫苗 在阿根廷获得批准,但尚未纳入国家免疫计划。 [10.52226/r4wnfk81]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: RSV vaccines are effective but costly, and post-licensure studies suggest an increased risk of Guillain-Barre syndrome (GBS). The review concludes that RSV vaccination averts more quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs) from RSV than vaccine-associated GBS. [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129023]

A total of 54 children participated (RSV: 22, hMPV: 32; male: 31, female: 23; median age: 3 years, range: 11 months to 11 years). No cross-infection was observed during the 1- to 3-month follow-up period. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10342440/v1]

RSV vaccines have been developed and approved by the FDA, with Arexvy, Abrysvo, and mRESVIA being notable examples. Monoclonal antibodies such as Nirsevimab and Clesrovimab are also used to prevent severe RSV disease in infants. [10.1186/s40794-026-00313-3]

At 75% coverage, vaccination with aRSVPreF3 was predicted to prevent 1,253,641 and 1,083,247 RSV-ARI cases, and 552,517 and 579,008 RSV-LRTD cases in older adults and at-risk individuals, respectively, over 5 years. Direct healthcare costs were reduced by €240,849,821 and €331,050,265 in these groups. [10.1007/s10198-026-01968-7]

The review reports that RSV vaccination in adults reduces illness, complications, and hospitalization in high-risk groups, and notes that two vaccines are approved in Argentina but not yet included in the National Immunization Schedule. [10.52226/r4wnfk81]

news.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 该报告介绍了英格兰每月 RSV 孕产妇 疫苗接种 覆盖率,强调了 2026 年 3 月分娩的孕妇中 疫苗 的使用情况。这是英国健康安全局发布的官方统计数据。 [news-17b2b651b64d9faf]
在突破性感染中检测到 尼塞韦单抗 耐药 RSV-B 变种的首个大规模真实世界证据;研究作者强调,阻力仍然仅限于突破性案例。 [news-b6c95bc1f4228d76]
英国健康安全局发布的关于英格兰老年人 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 疫苗接种 吸收率的官方统计报告。 [news-40589758d3b13a46]
据《今日感染控制》报道,FDA 接受了默克公司的申请,将 ENFLONSIA 保护范围扩大到 RSV 第二季。 [news-1b0e511f4f8f896c]
呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是五岁以下儿童急性下呼吸道感染的主要原因,对全世界儿童健康构成持续威胁。婴儿早期感染 RSV 会显着增加患儿童哮喘的风险,尤其是有过敏或哮喘家族史的儿童。RSV 还会导致老年人出现严重后果和心脏并发症。 [news-0b69aae3a309b27f]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Respiratory syncytial virus news developments.
key_findings_en: The report presents the monthly RSV maternal vaccination coverage in England, highlighting the uptake of the vaccine among pregnant women who delivered in March 2026. It is an official statistics release by the UK Health Security Agency. [news-17b2b651b64d9faf]

First large-scale real-world evidence of nirsevimab-resistant RSV-B variants detected in breakthrough infections; study authors emphasize resistance remains confined to breakthrough cases. [news-b6c95bc1f4228d76]
Official statistics report on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccination uptake among older adults in England, published by the UK Health Security Agency. [news-40589758d3b13a46]
FDA accepts Merck's application to expand ENFLONSIA protection into the second RSV season, reported by Infection Control Today. [news-1b0e511f4f8f896c]
Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute lower respiratory infections in children under five and poses a persistent threat to child health worldwide. [news-0b69aae3a309b27f]

papers.title: Evaluating the cost-effectiveness of respiratory syncytial virus vaccination among risk-stratified older adults.
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disproportionately affects older adults with chronic conditions. RSV vaccines are effective but costly, and post-licensure studies suggest increased risk of Guillain-Barre syndrome (GBS). We evaluated cost-effectiveness and risk-benefit trade-offs of RSV vaccination by simulating RSV vaccination in adults aged ≥75 years and in adults aged 50-74 years with chronic conditions associated with increased risk of severe RSV disease. Data came from vaccine trials, peer-reviewed literature, observational vaccine effectiveness (VE) studies, and surveillance networks such as RSV-NET. Vaccine protection was assumed to last between 2 and 3 years. We estimated RSV vaccination averts more quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs) from RSV than vaccine-associated GBS. Societal cost-effectiveness varies substantially depending on age, risk condition, and duration of VE. RSV vaccination of adults aged ≥75 years costs $45,769 (95% uncertainty interval, UI: $25,505-$84,871) per quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) for protein subunit vaccines with 3 years of effectiveness; $100,571 (UI: $58,277-$225,885)/QALY for mRNA vaccine with 2 years of effectiveness; and $70,731 (UI: $42,069-$159,451) for mRNA vaccine with 3 years of effectiveness. Vaccination of adults aged 60-74 years with at least one chronic condition costs $21,721 (UI: cost-saving-$120,989)/QALY for protein subunit vaccines with 3 years effectiveness; $85,781 (UI: $3368-$409,467)/QALY for mRNA vaccine with 2 years of effectiveness; and $50,864 (UI: $3668-$249,938)/QALY for mRNA vaccine with 3 years of effectiveness. Vaccination of adults aged 50-59 years with at least one chronic condition costs $43,070 (UI: cost-saving-$266,769)/QALY for protein subunit vaccines with 3 years of effectiveness; $152,293 (UI: $1154-$811,138)/QALY for mRNA vaccine with 2 years of effectiveness; and $95,182 (UI: cost-saving-$682,508) for mRNA vaccine with 3 years of effectiveness. Regardless of the vaccine used, vaccination of adults aged 60-74 years without chronic conditions has high incremental cost effectiveness ratios ($287,793 to $503,328/QALY). If RSV disease had higher incidence, costs, or mortality, vaccination would be more cost-effective.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review evaluates the cost-effectiveness of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccination among risk-stratified older adults, specifically adults aged ≥75 years and adults aged 50-74 years with chronic conditions associated with increased risk of severe RSV disease.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes vaccine trials, peer-reviewed literature, observational vaccine effectiveness (VE) studies, and surveillance networks such as RSV-NET. The review uses simulation models to estimate cost-effectiveness and risk-benefit trade-offs.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: RSV vaccines are effective but costly, and post-licensure studies suggest an increased risk of Guillain-Barre syndrome (GBS). The review concludes that RSV vaccination averts more quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs) from RSV than vaccine-associated GBS.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The cost-effectiveness of RSV vaccination varies substantially depending on age, risk condition, and duration of VE. The review notes that vaccine protection was assumed to last between 2 and 3 years, and there is uncertainty about the long-term effectiveness and safety of RSV vaccines.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that if RSV disease had higher incidence, costs, or mortality, vaccination would be more cost-effective. It also highlights the need for further research on the long-term effectiveness and safety of RSV vaccines, particularly in different age groups and populations with varying risk profiles.

analysis.summary_en: This review assesses the cost-effectiveness of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccination in older adults, focusing on those aged ≥75 years and adults aged 50-74 years with chronic conditions. The evidence base includes vaccine trials, observational studies, and surveillance networks. RSV vaccines are found to be effective but costly, with post-licensure studies indicating an increased risk of Guillain-Barre syndrome (GBS). The review concludes that RSV vaccination averts more quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs) than vaccine-associated GBS. However, cost-effectiveness varies significantly based on age, risk condition, and duration of vaccine effectiveness. The implications suggest that higher incidence or mortality of RSV disease could enhance the cost-effectiveness of vaccination. Further research is needed to better understand long-term vaccine effectiveness and safety across different populations.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该评价评估了 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 疫苗接种 在风险分层老年人中的成本效益,特别是年龄≥75岁的成年人和患有与严重 RSV 疾病风险增加相关的慢性病的 50-74 岁成年人。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础包括 疫苗 试验、同行评审文献、观察性 疫苗 有效性 (VE) 研究和 监测 网络(例如 RSV-NET)。该审查使用模拟模型来估计成本效益和风险收益权衡。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: RSV 疫苗 有效但成本高昂,并且许可后研究表明吉兰-巴利综合征 (GBS) 的风险增加。审查得出的结论是,与 疫苗 相关的 GBS 相比,RSV 疫苗接种 可以避免更多来自 RSV 的质量调整生命年 (QALY)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: RSV 疫苗接种 的成本效益根据年龄、风险状况和 VE 持续时间而有很大差异。审查指出,疫苗 的保护被假定持续 2 至 3 年,RSV 疫苗 的长期有效性和安全性存在不确定性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查表明,如果 RSV 疾病具有更高的 发病率、成本,或 死亡率、疫苗接种 将更具成本效益。它还强调需要进一步研究 RSV 疫苗 的长期有效性和安全性,特别是在不同年龄组和具有不同风险状况的人群中。

papers.title: A comprehensive look at Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV): from pathogenesis to prevention.
papers.abstract: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is a formidable respiratory pathogen that particularly affects infants and children. RSV presents with diverse clinical severity, most often causing mild upper airway symptoms but sometimes progressing to severe and potentially fatal lower respiratory tract disease. This virus has a major global public health impact and places a substantial strain on healthcare systems. RSV exhibits distinct seasonal trends that vary across geographic locations and climate zones, and recognizing these patterns and their determinants is essential for policymakers to schedule RSV immunization programs effectively. Increasing attention has been directed toward the evolving landscape of RSV vaccines, particularly regarding their potential to prevent infection and reduce disease severity, especially among vulnerable populations. Until now, three RSV vaccines, Arexvy, Abrysvo, and mRESVIA, have received approval from the FDA. In addition, monoclonal antibodies such as Nirsevimab and Clesrovimab prevent severe RSV disease and are recommended for infants. Given the significant global impact of RSV, this narrative review addresses its multifaceted aspects, including epidemiology and global impact, clinical manifestations, therapeutic strategies, vaccine development, and its emerging potential as an oncolytic agent.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是一种可怕的呼吸道病原体,尤其影响婴儿和儿童。RSV 具有不同的临床严重程度,最常引起轻微的上呼吸道症状,但有时会进展为严重且可能致命的下呼吸道疾病。这种病毒对全球公共卫生产生重大影响,并对医疗保健系统造成巨大压力。RSV 表现出明显的季节性趋势,这些趋势因地理位置和气候带而异,认识到这些模式及其决定因素对于政策制定者有效安排 RSV 免疫计划至关重要。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 RSV 现有文献的叙述性综合,重点关注其 流行病学、临床表现、治疗策略、疫苗 的开发以及作为溶瘤剂的潜力。尽管所提供的文本中没有明确详细说明具体的数据库、检索日期和资格标准,但证据来自一系列研究和报告。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: RSV 疫苗 已开发并获得 FDA 批准,其中 Arexvy、Abrysvo 和 mRESVIA 是著名的例子。尼塞韦单抗 和 Clesrovimab 等单克隆抗体也用于预防婴儿严重 RSV 疾病。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了对 RSV 疫苗 进行进一步研究的必要性,特别是关于它们在易感人群中预防感染和减轻疾病严重程度的潜力。还需要更好地了解 RSV 的季节性趋势及其决定因素,以改进免疫接种计划。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 显然需要继续研究和开发 RSV 疫苗 和单克隆抗体,以解决 RSV 对全球公共卫生的影响。此外,还需要改进 监测 并了解 RSV 的季节性模式,以优化免疫计划。

RSV presents with diverse clinical severity, most often causing mild upper airway symptoms but sometimes progressing to severe and potentially fatal lower respiratory tract disease. RSV exhibits distinct seasonal trends that vary across geographic locations and climate zones, and recognizing these patterns and their determinants is essential for policymakers to schedule RSV immunization programs effectively. papers.title: Cost-effectiveness of a single dose of the adjuvanted respiratory syncytial virus preFusion protein 3 vaccine over 5 years and its potential public health impact among older adults in Italy.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus-associated acute respiratory illness (RSV-ARI) is an underrecognized cause of illness in older adults aged ≥ 75 years (OAs) and individuals at increased risk (AIR), contributing to a substantial disease burden. AS01E-adjuvanted RSV PreFusion protein 3 vaccine (aRSVPreF3) is approved for the prevention of RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) in OAs. This study assesses the cost-effectiveness of a single dose of aRSVPreF3 vaccine among OAs and AIR individuals aged 60-74 years over 5 years in Italy. METHODS: A static multi-cohort Markov model with 5-year horizon and 1-month cycle length was developed to model the effect of aRSVPreF3 vaccination. Inputs were obtained from national databases and scientific literature. Sensitivity analyses were performed to assess the robustness of the results to variations in input parameters. RESULTS: At 75% coverage, aRSVPreF3 vaccination was predicted to prevent 1,253,641 and 1,083,247 RSV-ARI cases, and 552,517 and 579,008 RSV-LRTD cases, with direct healthcare costs reduced by €240,849,821 and €331,050,265 over a 5-year period in OAs and AIR individuals, respectively. Vaccination of OAs and AIR individuals was estimated to prevent 58,129 and 102,786 quality-adjusted life-year losses, yielding incremental cost-effectiveness ratios of €13,832 and €4,529, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Vaccination of OAs and AIR individuals with one dose of aRSVPreF3 has the potential to reduce RSV disease-associated burden and direct costs for the Italian National Healthcare System over a 5-year period. These results could support policymakers and clinicians in decision-making processes around the recommendation and implementation of RSV vaccination in Italy.

papers.title: No Cross-Infection between Respiratory Syncytial Virus and Human Metapneumovirus in a Shared Sick-Child Care Setting: A Prospective Observational Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background A simultaneous outbreak of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) occurred in Ube, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan, from January to April 2025. Both viruses belong to the family Pneumoviridae and cause clinically similar respiratory illnesses in children. Whether sharing a care room between RSV-infected and hMPV-infected children leads to cross-infection has not been previously investigated. Methods Children aged 11 months to 11 years who tested positive for RSV or hMPV by rapid antigen tests at Suzuki Pediatric Clinic were enrolled in the sick-child care facility of the same clinic. RSV-positive and hMPV-positive children were cared for in the same room. Cross-infection was prospectively monitored for 1 to 4 months after discharge. Results A total of 54 children participated (RSV: 22, hMPV: 32; male: 31, female: 23; median age: 3 years, range: 11 months to 11 years). Shared care was conducted over 23 sessions from January to April 2025, with 2 to 7 children per session in rooms measuring 10.4 to 22.4 m2. No cross-infection was observed during the 1- to 3-month follow-up period. One RSV-infected infant (aged 11 months) subsequently developed hMPV infection 21 days after discharge; however, given that this interval exceeds the known incubation period of hMPV (3–6 days), this case was considered a community-acquired infection. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether cross-infection occurs between respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) in a shared sick-child care setting. A prospective observational study was conducted at Suzuki Pediatric Clinic in Japan, enrolling children aged 11 months to 11 years who tested positive for RSV or hMPV. No cross-infection was observed during the 1- to 3-month follow-up period, with one case of hMPV infection in an RSV-infected infant considered community-acquired due to the time interval exceeding the known incubation period. The authors suggest that viral interference, possibly through the innate immune response, may explain the lack of cross-infection. The study's observational design and short follow-up period limit its generalizability, but the direct monitoring of cross-infection in a clinical setting supports its conclusions.

papers.title: Recomendación de vacunación contra el virus sincicial respiratorio (VSR) en adultos Recommendation for vaccination against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in adults
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a predominantly seasonal pathogen with an increasing incidence in Argentina (1). It is most prevalent among children under 2 years of age and older adults, particularly those with risk factors (cardiovascular diseases, chronic respiratory diseases, diabetes, immunocompromised individuals). Since there is no effective treatment for its management, disease prevention is of particular importance. Numerous studies have demonstrated that RSV vaccination in adults reduces the risk of illness, complications, and hospitalization in the most vulnerable populations (2, 3). Several countries have incorporated RSV immunization for adults into their respective immunization schedules in recent years. Although two vaccines are approved in our country, they have not yet been incorporated into the National Immunization Schedule. The Argentine Society of Infectious Diseases, through its Vaccine Commission, has issued this document, which provides valuable guidance for considering adult vaccination against this pathogen.

papers.title: An evaluation of the anti-human respiratory syncytial virus activity of sophora alkaloids and the enhanced efficacy by liposomes via intratracheal administration
papers.abstract: Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe lower respiratory tract infections and related deaths in infants, young children, and the elderly. The clinical management of RSV is challenging due to its high mutation rate and the limited efficacy and safety of existing antiviral drugs. Sophora alkaloids, natural compounds derived from Sophora flavescens, exhibit broad-spectrum antiviral and immunomodulatory activities. Mechanistically, RSV relies on ERK1/2 phosphorylation to facilitate viral replication and spread, while sophora alkaloids inhibit ERK1/2 phosphorylation via regulating MEK/ERK signaling pathway, thereby suppressing viral proliferation and the inflammatory response caused by RSV infection. In vivo studies demonstrated that sophora alkaloids significantly reduced the mortality of RSV-infected mice via intratracheal administration. To further enhance the pulmonary retention of drugs, liposomes were used to improve the therapeutic effects of sophora alkaloids. As the most effective sophora alkaloids against RSV infection, sophocarpine (SC) was encapsulated in liposomes to enhance its anti-RSV infection effect. In vivo studies demonstrate that SC-loaded liposomes outperformed the free SC in suppressing RSV replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation in murine models of RSV infection. This study not only clarifies the mechanism by which sophora alkaloids counteract RSV-infection but also provides liposomal formulation of SC to improve the anti-RSV therapeutic effects.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe lower respiratory tract infections and related deaths in infants, young children, and the elderly. The clinical management of RSV is challenging due to its high mutation rate and the limited efficacy and safety of existing antiviral drugs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: In vivo studies were conducted using murine models of RSV infection to evaluate the anti-RSV activity of sophora alkaloids and their liposomal formulations.
analysis.methods: Sophora alkaloids, particularly sophocarpine (SC), were encapsulated in liposomes to enhance pulmonary retention and therapeutic effects. The mechanism of action involved inhibition of ERK1/2 phosphorylation via regulation of the MEK/ERK signaling pathway.
analysis.main_results: In vivo studies demonstrated that sophora alkaloids significantly reduced the mortality of RSV-infected mice via intratracheal administration. SC-loaded liposomes outperformed free SC in suppressing RSV replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation in murine models.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study clarifies that sophora alkaloids counteract RSV infection by inhibiting ERK1/2 phosphorylation and suppressing viral proliferation and inflammatory response. The liposomal formulation of SC provides a novel approach to improve anti-RSV therapeutic effects.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that liposomal sophocarpine could be a promising therapeutic strategy for RSV infection, potentially improving treatment outcomes in high-risk populations such as infants, young children, and the elderly.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on in vivo murine models, which may not fully translate to human clinical outcomes. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the study demonstrates efficacy in animal models but requires further validation in human trials.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the anti-human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) activity of sophora alkaloids, particularly sophocarpine (SC), and their enhanced efficacy when encapsulated in liposomes via intratracheal administration. The research demonstrated that sophora alkaloids inhibit RSV replication by suppressing ERK1/2 phosphorylation through the MEK/ERK signaling pathway, reducing mortality in RSV-infected mice. Liposomal encapsulation of SC significantly improved therapeutic outcomes by enhancing pulmonary retention and outperforming free SC in suppressing viral replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation. These findings provide a novel approach for RSV treatment, potentially addressing the challenges posed by the virus's high mutation rate and the limitations of existing antiviral drugs.

elements_zh.methods: 槐生物碱,特别是槐果碱 (SC),被封装在脂质体中以增强肺滞留和治疗效果。作用机制涉及通过调节 MEK/ERK 信号通路抑制 ERK1/2 磷酸化。
elements_zh.main_results: 体内研究表明,槐花生物碱通过气管内给药可显着降低 RSV 感染小鼠的 死亡率。在小鼠模型中,负载 SC 的脂质体在抑制 RSV 复制和减轻肺部炎症方面优于游离 SC。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究阐明,槐花生物碱通过抑制 ERK1/2 磷酸化、抑制病毒增殖和炎症反应来抵抗 RSV 感染。SC的脂质体制剂为提高抗RSV治疗效果提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,脂质体槐果碱可能是 RSV 感染的一种有前途的治疗策略,有可能改善婴儿、幼儿和老年人等高危人群的 治疗 结局。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于体内小鼠模型,可能无法完全转化为人类临床结果。证据的强度是中等的,因为该研究在动物模型中证明了有效性,但需要在人体试验中进一步验证。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe lower respiratory tract infections and related deaths in infants, young children, and the elderly. The clinical management of RSV is challenging due to its high mutation rate and the limited efficacy and safety of existing antiviral drugs.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: In vivo studies were conducted using murine models of RSV infection to evaluate the anti-RSV activity of sophora alkaloids and their liposomal formulations.
analysis_en.methods: Sophora alkaloids, particularly sophocarpine (SC), were encapsulated in liposomes to enhance pulmonary retention and therapeutic effects. The mechanism of action involved inhibition of ERK1/2 phosphorylation via regulation of the MEK/ERK signaling pathway.
analysis_en.main_results: In vivo studies demonstrated that sophora alkaloids significantly reduced the mortality of RSV-infected mice via intratracheal administration. SC-loaded liposomes outperformed free SC in suppressing RSV replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation in murine models.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study clarifies that sophora alkaloids counteract RSV infection by inhibiting ERK1/2 phosphorylation and suppressing viral proliferation and inflammatory response. The liposomal formulation of SC provides a novel approach to improve anti-RSV therapeutic effects.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that liposomal sophocarpine could be a promising therapeutic strategy for RSV infection, potentially improving treatment outcomes in high-risk populations such as infants, young children, and the elderly.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on in vivo murine models, which may not fully translate to human clinical outcomes. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the study demonstrates efficacy in animal models but requires further validation in human trials.

papers.title_zh: 槐生物碱的抗人呼吸道合胞病毒活性评价及脂质体气管内给药增强功效的评价
papers.source_body_en: Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe lower respiratory tract infections and related deaths in infants, young children, and the elderly. The clinical management of RSV is challenging due to its high mutation rate and the limited efficacy and safety of existing antiviral drugs. Sophora alkaloids, natural compounds derived from Sophora flavescens, exhibit broad-spectrum antiviral and immunomodulatory activities. Mechanistically, RSV relies on ERK1/2 phosphorylation to facilitate viral replication and spread, while sophora alkaloids inhibit ERK1/2 phosphorylation via regulating MEK/ERK signaling pathway, thereby suppressing viral proliferation and the inflammatory response caused by RSV infection. In vivo studies demonstrated that sophora alkaloids significantly reduced the mortality of RSV-infected mice via intratracheal administration. To further enhance the pulmonary retention of drugs, liposomes were used to improve the therapeutic effects of sophora alkaloids. As the most effective sophora alkaloids against RSV infection, sophocarpine (SC) was encapsulated in liposomes to enhance its anti-RSV infection effect. In vivo studies demonstrate that SC-loaded liposomes outperformed the free SC in suppressing RSV replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation in murine models of RSV infection. This study not only clarifies the mechanism by which sophora alkaloids counteract RSV-infection but also provides liposomal formulation of SC to improve the anti-RSV therapeutic effects.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是婴儿、幼儿和老年人严重下呼吸道感染和相关死亡的主要原因。由于 RSV 的高 突变 发生率以及现有 抗病毒药物 药物的疗效和安全性有限,RSV 的临床管理具有挑战性。苦参生物碱是从苦参中提取的天然化合物,具有广谱 抗病毒药物 和免疫调节活性。从机制上讲,RSV依赖ERK1/2磷酸化来促进病毒复制和传播,而槐花生物碱通过调节MEK/ERK信号通路抑制ERK1/2磷酸化,从而抑制病毒增殖和RSV感染引起的炎症反应。体内研究表明,槐花生物碱通过气管内给药可显着降低 RSV 感染小鼠的 死亡率。为了进一步增强药物的肺滞留,采用脂质体来提高苦参生物碱的治疗效果。槐果碱(SC)作为抗RSV感染最有效的生物碱,将其封装在脂质体中以增强其抗RSV感染的效果。体内研究表明,在 RSV 感染的小鼠模型中,负载 SC 的脂质体在抑制 RSV 复制和减轻肺部炎症方面优于游离 SC。本研究不仅阐明了槐花生物碱抗RSV感染的机制,而且提供了SC的脂质体制剂,以提高抗RSV的治疗效果。

papers.title: Therapeutic potential of nutritional aryl hydrocarbon receptor ligands for respiratory syncytial virus infection: a mini review
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection is still a major cause of hospitalization of young children and older adults. Despite recent significant advances, critical gaps remain in prevention strategies, particularly for older infants and underserved populations, and to date there is no specific treatment available. The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) is a transcription factor initially identified as mediator of the toxic effects of environmental pollutants that was later found to be also activated by ligands derived from food, the gut microbiome, and host metabolism. AHR activation by these naturally occurring, or nutritional, ligands has been associated with beneficial physiological processes. Notably, AHR has critical functions in barrier organs such as the lungs, including regulation of immune responses to infection. AHR activation is a common strategy for many viruses to evade antiviral immunity, but in a recently published study we found that during RSV infection the AHR pathway is downregulated and plays a protective role, and the administration of the dietary AHR pro-ligand indole-3-carbinol (I3C) to RSV-infected mice led to beneficial effects. Here we review and discuss studies indicating nutritional AHR ligands, particularly compounds derived from cruciferous vegetables or generated during the metabolism of tryptophan, may offer therapeutic benefit for RSV disease, by positively modulating inflammation and reducing excessive immune responses, oxidative stress, and viral replication.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the therapeutic potential of nutritional aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) ligands for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection. RSV remains a significant cause of hospitalization in young children and older adults, with no specific treatment available. The AHR, initially identified as a mediator of environmental pollutants, is also activated by dietary and microbial ligands. It plays a protective role in the lungs during RSV infection, as demonstrated by a study showing that the dietary AHR ligand indole-3-carbinol (I3C) improved outcomes in RSV-infected mice. The review highlights the need for further research into the use of nutritional AHR ligands to modulate inflammation, reduce immune overactivation, oxidative stress, and viral replication in RSV disease. However, critical gaps persist in prevention strategies, especially for vulnerable populations.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 感染仍然是幼儿和老年人住院的主要原因。在这里,我们回顾并讨论了一些研究,这些研究表明营养性 AHR 配体,特别是源自十字花科蔬菜或色氨酸代谢过程中产生的化合物,可能通过积极调节炎症和减少过度的 免疫应答、氧化应激和病毒复制,为 RSV 疾病提供治疗益处。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于最近发表的一项研究,其中 AHR 激活是许多病毒逃避 抗病毒药物 免疫的常见策略,但在 RSV 感染期间,AHR 途径下调并发挥保护作用,并且给 RSV 感染小鼠施用膳食 AHR 前配体吲哚-3-甲醇 (I3C) 会产生有益效果。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: AHR 激活是许多病毒逃避 抗病毒药物 免疫的常见策略,但在最近发表的一项研究中,我们发现在 RSV 感染期间,AHR 通路下调并发挥保护作用,并且给 RSV 感染小鼠施用膳食 AHR 前配体吲哚-3-甲醇 (I3C) 会产生有益效果。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管最近取得了重大进展,但预防策略仍然存在重大差距,特别是对于年龄较大的婴儿和服务不足的人群,而且迄今为止还没有具体的 治疗 可用。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些天然存在的或营养性配体激活的 AHR 与有益的生理过程相关。值得注意的是,AHR 在肺部等屏障器官中具有关键功能,包括调节 免疫应答 对感染的影响。

papers.title: Stabilization of prefusion hMPV F improves manufacturability and protective immunity across hMPV lineages.
papers.abstract: Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a major cause of pediatric acute lower respiratory tract infections (ALRTIs), yet vaccine development has been hindered by the intrinsic metastability of the prefusion F glycoprotein (pre-F). Here, we used a structure-based design strategy to stabilize hMPV pre-F while preserving neutralization-sensitive epitopes. By applying combined stabilizing elements, including disulfide bonds, a designed salt bridge, and a trimer-interface sequence swap, we generated VM-874, a pre-F-stabilized trimer that was expressed at high levels in 293F cells and exhibited improved thermal stability and stress-resistant antigenicity. VM-874 also retained binding to multiple conformation-sensitive monoclonal antibodies following thermal and storage stress. VM-874 elicited high serum neutralizing titers against both hMPV A2 and B1 strains and conferred protection in BALB/c mice and cotton rats, as evidenced by reduced pulmonary viral burden and attenuated lung pathology after challenge. Although VM-874 elicited antibodies that cross-bound respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) F protein, no RSV-neutralizing activity was detected, underscoring the need to distinguish cross-reactivity from heterologous protection in combined RSV/hMPV vaccine strategies.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed a structure-based design strategy to engineer a stabilized hMPV pre-F trimer, VM-874, which was expressed in 293F cells and evaluated for stability and antigenicity.
analysis.methods: Stabilization was achieved through combined elements including disulfide bonds, a designed salt bridge, and a trimer-interface sequence swap, with thermal stability and stress-resistant antigenicity assessed using conformation-sensitive monoclonal antibodies.

analysis.summary_en: Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a leading cause of pediatric respiratory disease, but vaccine development has been hindered by the intrinsic instability of the prefusion F glycoprotein (pre-F). This study used structure-based design to stabilize hMPV pre-F, generating VM-874, a trimer expressed in 293F cells that exhibited improved thermal stability and retained binding to conformation-sensitive antibodies under stress. VM-874 elicited high neutralizing titers against hMPV A2 and B1 strains and protected mice and cotton rats from challenge, reducing viral burden and lung pathology. The authors conclude that stabilizing pre-F preserves protective epitopes and enhances manufacturability, offering a novel path for hMPV vaccine development. While the findings are promising, the study did not assess cross-protection against RSV despite cross-binding, and evidence strength is moderate due to reliance on animal models without human clinical validation.

papers.title: Sparfloxacin reveals a host–virus dual-target antiviral scaffold against respiratory syncytial virus
papers.abstract: Abstract Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe respiratory illness across the lifespan, particularly in infants and older adults. Nonetheless, effective antiviral therapies remain limited. Here, we performed a clinically guided, medium-throughput screening of approved drugs used in pediatric populations and identified sparfloxacin (SPFX), a fluoroquinolone antibiotic, as a mechanistically informative antiviral scaffold. SPFX showed antiviral activity against genetically distinct RSV clinical isolates in vitro, and suppressed RSV infection in a mechanistic mouse model in vivo. Mechanistically, our findings support a host–virus dual-target framework in which SPFX suppresses RSV replication through activity consistent with modulation of viral RNA polymerase function together with a pro-viral HSP70-associated host pathway. Using primary human pediatric airway epithelial cells, we identified SPFX-responsive host factors and observed suppression of HSP70 expression independent of infection. Together, these findings establish SPFX as a mechanistically informative antiviral scaffold and support a host–virus dual-target framework for future RSV therapeutic development.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是一生中严重呼吸道疾病的主要原因,尤其是婴儿和老年人。尽管如此,有效的 抗病毒药物 疗法仍然有限。在这里,我们对用于儿科人群的已批准药物进行了临床指导的中通量筛选,并确定了司帕沙星(SPFX)(一种氟喹诺酮抗生素)作为机械信息丰富的 抗病毒药物 支架。SPFX 在体外显示出 抗病毒药物 针对遗传上不同的 RSV 临床分离株的活性,并在体内机械小鼠模型中抑制 RSV 感染。从机制上讲,我们的研究结果支持 宿主 病毒双靶框架,其中 SPFX 通过与病毒 RNA 聚合酶功能调节一致的活性以及前病毒 HSP70 相关的 宿主 途径来抑制 RSV 复制。使用原代人儿科气道上皮细胞,我们鉴定了 SPFX 反应性 宿主 因子,并观察到 ​​HSP70 表达的抑制与感染无关。总之,这些发现将 SPFX 确立为一种机械信息丰富的 抗病毒药物 支架,并支持未来 RSV 治疗开发的 宿主 病毒双靶点框架。

papers.title: Respiratory Viral Detection and Invasive Bacterial Infections in Infants ≤90 Days.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Comprehensive data are needed to guide the use and interpretation of molecular respiratory viral testing in evaluating infants 0 to ≤90 days old for invasive bacterial infections (IBIs). We aimed to describe the frequency and severity of respiratory viral infections in febrile and nonfebrile infants 0 to ≤90 days of age with emergency department visits or hospitalizations for acute respiratory illness and to quantify the occurrence of IBI (bacteremia and bacterial meningitis) in these groups. METHODS: The New Vaccine Surveillance Network conducts acute respiratory illness surveillance at 7 US pediatric medical institutions in the United States. We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of febrile and nonfebrile infants 0 to ≤90 days of age enrolled in the emergency department or inpatient hospital settings. Respiratory viral detection from research respiratory samples in the context of clinical severity and IBI was examined. RESULTS: Three thousand seven hundred and eighty febrile and nonfebrile infants 0 to ≤90 days of age enrolled from December 1, 2016, to March 31, 2020. Respiratory syncytial virus was the most common virus detected regardless of febrile status. IBIs were significantly more frequent in febrile infants without a respiratory virus compared with those with a respiratory virus detected (4.9% vs. IBIs were not detected in infants with respiratory syncytial virus (n = 259), parainfluenza virus (n = 66), human metapneumovirus (n = 13), influenza virus (n = 67), or adenovirus (n = 11) alone. IBI and respiratory viral coinfections were found in infants with endemic coronaviruses (5.8%, 3/52), rhinovirus/enterovirus (2.2%, 7/324) and viral coinfections (2.0%, 2/99). CONCLUSIONS: These data suggest that febrile infants 0 to ≤90 days old with certain respiratory viruses are at lower risk of IBI.

METHODS: The New Vaccine Surveillance Network conducts acute respiratory illness surveillance at 7 US pediatric medical institutions in the United States. RESULTS: Three thousand seven hundred and eighty febrile and nonfebrile infants 0 to ≤90 days of age enrolled from December 1, 2016, to March 31, 2020. Respiratory syncytial virus was the most common virus detected regardless of febrile status. papers.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals dysregulation of innate immune signaling in early-life respiratory syncytial virus infection with subsequent low-level cadmium exposure
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Early-life respiratory syncytial virus infection (eRSV) causes severe respiratory illness in vulnerable populations and has a significant global health burden. eRSV-associated pathologies are exacerbated by low levels of cadmium (Cd) in the diet, leading to increased cytokine and chemokine levels, inhibited autophagy by mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) signaling and enhanced fibrosis. In this study, we used single-cell RNA sequencing of lung samples from mice subjected to eRSV at 2 weeks of age, followed by low-dose Cd (3.3 mg CdCl 2 /L in drinking water from 5 weeks old to 21 weeks old; eRSV+Cd) to determine responsive cell populations and identify new mechanistic targets. Alveolar macrophages exhibited the strongest response to eRSV+Cd treatment, with evidence of activated mTORC1 signaling and changes to macrophage phenotypes. Extensive differential expression also occurred in other cell types involved in alveolar repair, and analysis of cell-cell signaling revealed a significant strengthening of galectin-9 signaling between endothelial and innate immune cells only with eRSV+Cd. These results support mTORC1 signaling in macrophages, macrophage polarization, and galectin-9 signaling as promising areas of study to mitigate lung damage in individuals affected by eRSV with subsequent dietary Cd exposures.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 生命早期的 呼吸道合胞病毒 感染 (eRSV) 通过使弱势群体出现严重呼吸道疾病而给全球健康带来巨大负担,但镉 (Cd) 等环境毒物对 呼吸道合胞病毒 疾病的综合影响仍不清楚。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于它依赖于小鼠模型和单细胞 RNA 测序,而没有进行体内功能验证,这限制了直接转化为人类临床环境,并将证据强度降低到中等。

papers.title_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序揭示了早期 呼吸道合胞病毒 感染以及随后的低水平镉暴露中先天免疫信号的失调
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Early-life respiratory syncytial virus infection (eRSV) causes severe respiratory illness in vulnerable populations and has a significant global health burden. eRSV-associated pathologies are exacerbated by low levels of cadmium (Cd) in the diet, leading to increased cytokine and chemokine levels, inhibited autophagy by mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) signaling and enhanced fibrosis. In this study, we used single-cell RNA sequencing of lung samples from mice subjected to eRSV at 2 weeks of age, followed by low-dose Cd (3.3 mg CdCl 2 /L in drinking water from 5 weeks old to 21 weeks old; eRSV+Cd) to determine responsive cell populations and identify new mechanistic targets. Alveolar macrophages exhibited the strongest response to eRSV+Cd treatment, with evidence of activated mTORC1 signaling and changes to macrophage phenotypes. Extensive differential expression also occurred in other cell types involved in alveolar repair, and analysis of cell-cell signaling revealed a significant strengthening of galectin-9 signaling between endothelial and innate immune cells only with eRSV+Cd. These results support mTORC1 signaling in macrophages, macrophage polarization, and galectin-9 signaling as promising areas of study to mitigate lung damage in individuals affected by eRSV with subsequent dietary Cd exposures.

papers.title: Inferring Spatial Transmission Dynamics of Respiratory Syncytial Virus Across Houston Wastewater Treatment Plants
papers.abstract: Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) is an effective, noninvasive tool for tracking community-level circulation of respiratory viruses, yet standard renewal models treat each wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) in isolation, even though respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) spreads through contact networks that cross service-area boundaries. Using weekly data from $m = 15$ Houston WWTPs, we extend a single-plant Bayesian renewal model by coupling neighboring WWTPs via a spatial weight matrix built using a novel Population Extended Hausdorff Distance, defined as a directional distance between WWTPs. This distance measures how far a WWTP must reach to access a meaningful share of a neighboring WWTP's residents. A single parameter $\rho$ controls spatial mixing in the plant-level growth rate, allowing us to recover the effective reproduction number $R_{it}$. We find that $\rho$ is estimated well above zero, indicating substantial cross-WWTP transmission that the independent-plant model cannot capture. Spatial coupling reshapes plant-level $R_{it}$ relative to the independent-plant baseline ($\rho = 0$) while leaving inferred infection trajectories essentially unchanged.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) is widely used to track community-level circulation of respiratory viruses, but standard renewal models often treat wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) in isolation, overlooking spatial transmission networks that may cross service-area boundaries for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used weekly data from 15 Houston WWTPs and extended a single-plant Bayesian renewal model by coupling neighboring WWTPs via a spatial weight matrix constructed using a novel Population Extended Hausdorff Distance.
analysis.methods: A spatial weight matrix was built using a Population Extended Hausdorff Distance to measure how far a WWTP must reach to access a meaningful share of a neighboring WWTP's residents, and a single parameter ρ controlled spatial mixing in the plant-level growth rate to recover the effective reproduction number R_it.
analysis.main_results: The parameter ρ was estimated well above zero, indicating substantial cross-WWTP transmission that the independent-plant model cannot capture, and spatial coupling reshaped plant-level R_it relative to the independent-plant baseline while leaving inferred infection trajectories essentially unchanged.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the substantial spatial mixing (ρ > 0) as evidence that RSV transmission crosses WWTP service-area boundaries, and the novelty lies in extending a single-plant Bayesian renewal model to incorporate spatial coupling between WWTPs using a Population Extended Hausdorff Distance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that wastewater surveillance for RSV should account for spatial transmission dynamics across WWTP boundaries to improve accuracy in estimating community-level transmission and informing public health interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on a single metropolitan area and a modeling framework that assumes spatial coupling via WWTPs reflects true human mobility and transmission patterns, warranting cautious generalizability and further validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study addressed a gap in wastewater-based epidemiology by demonstrating that respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) transmission crosses wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) service-area boundaries in Houston. Using weekly data from 15 WWTPs, the authors extended a single-plant Bayesian renewal model to incorporate spatial coupling via a Population Extended Hausdorff Distance, which quantifies how far a WWTP must reach to access a meaningful share of neighboring residents. A key parameter ρ controlling spatial mixing was estimated well above zero, indicating substantial cross-WWTP transmission that standard independent-plant models miss. Spatial coupling altered plant-level effective reproduction numbers (R_it) without changing inferred infection trajectories. The authors interpret these results as evidence that RSV transmission networks extend beyond administrative WWTP boundaries, highlighting the need for spatially explicit wastewater surveillance to improve public health decision-making.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了来自 15 个休斯敦污水处理厂的每周数据,并通过使用新型种群扩展豪斯多夫距离构建的空间权重矩阵耦合相邻污水处理厂,扩展了单厂贝叶斯更新模型。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) is widely used to track community-level circulation of respiratory viruses, but standard renewal models often treat wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) in isolation, overlooking spatial transmission networks that may cross service-area boundaries for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study used weekly data from 15 Houston WWTPs and extended a single-plant Bayesian renewal model by coupling neighboring WWTPs via a spatial weight matrix constructed using a novel Population Extended Hausdorff Distance.
analysis_en.methods: A spatial weight matrix was built using a Population Extended Hausdorff Distance to measure how far a WWTP must reach to access a meaningful share of a neighboring WWTP's residents, and a single parameter ρ controlled spatial mixing in the plant-level growth rate to recover the effective reproduction number R_it.
analysis_en.main_results: The parameter ρ was estimated well above zero, indicating substantial cross-WWTP transmission that the independent-plant model cannot capture, and spatial coupling reshaped plant-level R_it relative to the independent-plant baseline while leaving inferred infection trajectories essentially unchanged.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the substantial spatial mixing (ρ > 0) as evidence that RSV transmission crosses WWTP service-area boundaries, and the novelty lies in extending a single-plant Bayesian renewal model to incorporate spatial coupling between WWTPs using a Population Extended Hausdorff Distance.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that wastewater surveillance for RSV should account for spatial transmission dynamics across WWTP boundaries to improve accuracy in estimating community-level transmission and informing public health interventions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on a single metropolitan area and a modeling framework that assumes spatial coupling via WWTPs reflects true human mobility and transmission patterns, warranting cautious generalizability and further validation.

papers.title_zh: 推断休斯顿污水处理厂 呼吸道合胞病毒 的空间 传播 动态
papers.source_body_en: Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) is an effective, noninvasive tool for tracking community-level circulation of respiratory viruses, yet standard renewal models treat each wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) in isolation, even though respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) spreads through contact networks that cross service-area boundaries. Using weekly data from $m = 15$ Houston WWTPs, we extend a single-plant Bayesian renewal model by coupling neighboring WWTPs via a spatial weight matrix built using a novel Population Extended Hausdorff Distance, defined as a directional distance between WWTPs. This distance measures how far a WWTP must reach to access a meaningful share of a neighboring WWTP's residents. A single parameter $\rho$ controls spatial mixing in the plant-level growth rate, allowing us to recover the effective reproduction number $R_{it}$. We find that $\rho$ is estimated well above zero, indicating substantial cross-WWTP transmission that the independent-plant model cannot capture. Spatial coupling reshapes plant-level $R_{it}$ relative to the independent-plant baseline ($\rho = 0$) while leaving inferred infection trajectories essentially unchanged.

papers.title: Probe-based metagenomic sentinel surveillance of viral respiratory infections in primary care: a prospective, national, pilot study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: With the introduction of metagenomics in clinical diagnostics unfolding and the expanding role of pathogen genomics in national surveillance, conditions are favourable for the further maturation of these approaches in public health surveillance. In this study, we aimed to pilot the use of probe-based metagenomics for nationwide sentinel surveillance through general practitioner (GP) networks and for the genomic characterisation of both anticipated and emerging respiratory viruses in primary care. METHODS: This prospective, pilot study included patients with acute respiratory illness attending GP practices participating in nationwide sentinel virological surveillance in the Netherlands, from Jan 10, 2025, to April 25, 2025. On predefined selection days, 90-100 combined nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal swab specimens were analysed through parallel metagenomic testing using probes targeting 15 488 strains of human and animal viruses. Results were compared with a standard two-tiered surveillance strategy comprising PCR targeting 17 viruses, followed by amplicon-based nanopore whole-genome sequencing of influenza viruses, SARS-CoV-2, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The primary outcome was detection and in-depth genomic characterisation of viruses within and beyond the scope of standard screening. Sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values, and genome coverage were analysed. FINDINGS: 93 patients were included, with a median age of 51 years (IQR 33-67); 55 (59%) were women and 38 (41%) were men. Overall, 74 (80%) specimens tested positive through standard PCR-based screening. Metagenomic surveillance detected viruses in 88 (95%) specimens, including DNA viruses known to establish latent infections. For viruses targeted by routine PCR, metagenomics showed a pooled sensitivity of 93·8% (95% CI 88·1-98·7), specificity of 99·8% (95% CI 99·5-100·0), positive predictive value of 96·2% (95% CI 91·8-100·0), and negative predictive value of 99·7% (95% CI 91·8-100·0), with a median genome coverage of 99·4% (IQR 96·9-99·9%). Metagenomic data enabled simultaneous full genomic characterisation of circulating viruses targeted by current amplicon-based surveillance, including influenza viruses (success rate 30 [86%] of 35 detections) and RSV (six [86%] of seven), and of viruses that were post hoc characterised by whole-genome sequencing in response to epidemiological findings during the study period (human metapneumoviruses [hMPV], five [50·0%] of ten), and non-targeted viruses such as adenoviruses. The data facilitated characterisation of a reassortant A(H3N2) influenza virus, potential vaccine escape mutants, markers of susceptibility to influenza antiviral drugs and RSV monoclonal antibodies, and a human A(H1N2)v influenza virus infection. INTERPRETATION: The technically robust and comprehensive performance across heterogeneous circulating viruses shown here supports evaluation in larger prospective studies in high-prevalence settings, where implementation might be most cost-efficient. Further optimisation of probe-based enrichment strategies could reduce turnaround time and facilitate integration into routine public health surveillance. FUNDING: The Netherlands Organisation for Health Research and Development (ZonMw), and the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS).

analysis.summary_en: This prospective pilot study evaluated probe-based metagenomic sentinel surveillance for respiratory viruses in Dutch primary care from January to April 2025. Among 93 patients with acute respiratory illness, metagenomics detected viruses in 95% of specimens, including DNA viruses, and demonstrated high sensitivity (93.8%), specificity (99.8%), and genome coverage (median 99.4%) for viruses targeted by routine PCR. The method enabled simultaneous genomic characterisation of RSV and other respiratory viruses, including detection of a reassortant A(H3N2) influenza virus and a human A(H1N2)v infection. The authors conclude that probe-based metagenomics shows technically robust performance and supports further evaluation in larger, high-prevalence settings to assess cost-efficiency and integration into routine surveillance.

papers.title_zh: 初级保健中病毒性呼吸道感染的基于探针的宏基因组前哨 监测:一项前瞻性、全国性试点研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: With the introduction of metagenomics in clinical diagnostics unfolding and the expanding role of pathogen genomics in national surveillance, conditions are favourable for the further maturation of these approaches in public health surveillance. In this study, we aimed to pilot the use of probe-based metagenomics for nationwide sentinel surveillance through general practitioner (GP) networks and for the genomic characterisation of both anticipated and emerging respiratory viruses in primary care. METHODS: This prospective, pilot study included patients with acute respiratory illness attending GP practices participating in nationwide sentinel virological surveillance in the Netherlands, from Jan 10, 2025, to April 25, 2025. On predefined selection days, 90-100 combined nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal swab specimens were analysed through parallel metagenomic testing using probes targeting 15 488 strains of human and animal viruses. Results were compared with a standard two-tiered surveillance strategy comprising PCR targeting 17 viruses, followed by amplicon-based nanopore whole-genome sequencing of influenza viruses, SARS-CoV-2, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The primary outcome was detection and in-depth genomic characterisation of viruses within and beyond the scope of standard screening. Sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values, and genome coverage were analysed. FINDINGS: 93 patients were included, with a median age of 51 years (IQR 33-67); 55 (59%) were women and 38 (41%) were men. Overall, 74 (80%) specimens tested positive through standard PCR-based screening. Metagenomic surveillance detected viruses in 88 (95%) specimens, including DNA viruses known to establish latent infections. For viruses targeted by routine PCR, metagenomics showed a pooled sensitivity of 93·8% (95% CI 88·1-98·7), specificity of 99·8% (95% CI 99·5-100·0), positive predictive value of 96·2% (95% CI 91·8-100·0), and negative predictive value of 99·7% (95% CI 91·8-100·0), with a median genome coverage of 99·4% (IQR 96·9-99·9%). Metagenomic data enabled simultaneous full genomic characterisation of circulating viruses targeted by current amplicon-based surveillance, including influenza viruses (success rate 30 [86%] of 35 detections) and RSV (six [86%] of seven), and of viruses that were post hoc characterised by whole-genome sequencing in response to epidemiological findings during the study period (human metapneumoviruses [hMPV], five [50·0%] of ten), and non-targeted viruses such as adenoviruses. The data facilitated characterisation of a reassortant A(H3N2) influenza virus, potential vaccine escape mutants, markers of susceptibility to influenza antiviral drugs and RSV monoclonal antibodies, and a human A(H1N2)v influenza virus infection. INTERPRETATION: The technically robust and comprehensive performance across heterogeneous circulating viruses shown here supports evaluation in larger prospective studies in high-prevalence settings, where implementation might be most cost-efficient. Further optimisation of probe-based enrichment strategies could reduce turnaround time and facilitate integration into routine public health surveillance. FUNDING: The Netherlands Organisation for Health Research and Development (ZonMw), and the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS).

papers.title: Antimicrobial prescribing in adults with acute respiratory infections following rapid six-virus antigen testing: A prospective cohort study in Italian primary care
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The overuse of antibiotics for acute respiratory infections (ARIs) is a global challenge. While multiplex rapid antigen detection tests (RADTs) have been proposed to reduce clinical uncertainty, evidence regarding their impact on antimicrobial prescribing in outpatient settings is limited. We aimed to evaluate the association between multiplex RADT results and antimicrobial prescription rates in adult outpatients with ARIs. Methods This prospective cohort study was conducted in Genoa, Italy, during the 2025/2026 respiratory season. Community-dwelling adults (≥ 18 years) presenting to 27 general practitioners with an ARI were enrolled and followed for up to 30 days. At the index visit, patients underwent two nasopharyngeal swabs. The first was tested using a multiplex RADT targeting influenza A and B, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), SARS-CoV-2, metapneumovirus, and rhinovirus. The second swab was sent to a laboratory for testing via standard-of-care real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). The relative risk of antimicrobial prescribing between RADT-positive and RADT-negative patients was estimated using modified Poisson regression, adjusting for potential confounders. Results Of 682 patients tested by RADT, 18.6% tested positive for ≥ 1 virus; most cases were due to influenza A (7.8%) and RSV (5.9%). Compared to RT-PCR, the RADT showed low-to-moderate sensitivity (ranging from 0.7% for rhinovirus to 77.8% for SARS-CoV-2) and high specificity (> 99%). Sensitivity was higher for samples collected ≤ 3 days of symptom onset. Antibiotics were prescribed to 26.0% of RADT-positive and 33.9% of RADT-negative patients, with an adjusted relative risk of 0.73 (95% CI: 0.54–0.99). Antibiotic use was driven more by RADT results than RT-PCR: rates for true and false negatives (34.4% and 33.5%) were comparable, exceeding those for true and false positives (26.2% and 20.0%). All six antiviral prescriptions occurred among RADT-positive individuals. Conclusions A positive multiplex RADT result was associated with slightly reduced antibiotic prescribing and increased antiviral use. However, low-to-moderate sensitivity limits its utility as a universal rule-out tool. Multiplex RADTs could be best deployed as rule-in diagnostics for early presenters and high-risk patients who would benefit from prompt antiviral therapy, rather than as a general strategy to reduce overall antibiotic consumption. Clinical trial number: not applicable.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The overuse of antibiotics for acute respiratory infections (ARIs) is a global challenge, and while multiplex rapid antigen detection tests (RADTs) have been proposed to reduce clinical uncertainty, evidence regarding their impact on antimicrobial prescribing in outpatient settings is limited.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This prospective cohort study was conducted in Genoa, Italy, during the 2025/2026 respiratory season, enrolling community-dwelling adults (≥ 18 years) presenting to 27 general practitioners with an ARI and following them for up to 30 days.
analysis.methods: At the index visit, patients underwent two nasopharyngeal swabs: the first tested using a multiplex RADT targeting influenza A and B, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), SARS-CoV-2, metapneumovirus, and rhinovirus, and the second sent for standard-of-care RT-PCR testing. The relative risk of antimicrobial prescribing between RADT-positive and RADT-negative patients was estimated using modified Poisson regression, adjusting for potential confounders.
analysis.main_results: Of 682 patients tested by RADT, 18.6% tested positive for ≥ 1 virus, with most cases due to influenza A (7.8%) and RSV (5.9%). Antibiotics were prescribed to 26.0% of RADT-positive and 33.9% of RADT-negative patients, yielding an adjusted relative risk of 0.73 (95% CI: 0.54–0.99).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as indicating that a positive multiplex RADT result was associated with slightly reduced antibiotic prescribing and increased antiviral use, suggesting that multiplex RADTs could be best deployed as rule-in diagnostics for early presenters and high-risk patients rather than as a general strategy to reduce overall antibiotic consumption.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings cautiously inform that multiplex RADTs may support targeted antimicrobial stewardship in primary care by reducing unnecessary antibiotic prescriptions in RSV-positive adults, particularly when deployed early in high-risk patients who could benefit from prompt antiviral therapy.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The low-to-moderate sensitivity of the RADT, especially for RSV, limits its utility as a universal rule-out tool, and the study’s single-season, single-region design constrains generalisability, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective cohort study in Italian primary care evaluated whether multiplex rapid antigen detection tests (RADTs) targeting six respiratory viruses, including respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), could reduce unnecessary antibiotic prescribing in adults with acute respiratory infections. Among 682 adults, 18.6% tested positive by RADT, with RSV accounting for 5.9% of cases. Antibiotic prescriptions were lower in RADT-positive patients (26.0%) than in RADT-negative patients (33.9%), yielding an adjusted relative risk of 0.73 (95% CI: 0.54–0.99). The authors conclude that RADT results influenced prescribing behavior, reducing antibiotics but increasing antivirals, and recommend deploying RADTs as rule-in diagnostics for early presenters and high-risk patients rather than as a broad stewardship tool. However, the RADT’s low-to-moderate sensitivity, particularly for RSV, and the study’s single-season, single-region design limit generalisability and confidence in its findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 过度使用抗生素治疗急性呼吸道感染 (ARI) 是一项全球性挑战,虽然已提出多重快速抗原检测试验 (RADT) 来减少临床不确定性,但有关其对门诊抗菌药物处方影响的证据有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究于 2025/2026 年呼吸季节在意大利热那亚进行,招募了社区居住的成年人(≥ 18 岁),向 27 名患有 ARI 的全科医生就诊,并对他们进行长达 30 天的跟踪。
elements_zh.methods: 在初次访视时,患者接受了两次鼻咽拭子检测:第一次使用针对甲型和乙型流感、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV)、SARS-CoV-2、偏肺病毒和鼻病毒的多重 RADT 进行检测,第二次则进行标准护理 RT-PCR 检测。使用改良泊松回归估计 RADT 阳性和 RADT 阴性患者之间抗菌药物处方的相对风险,并调整潜在的混杂因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 RADT 检测的 682 名患者中,18.6% 的病毒检测呈 ≥ 1 种阳性,其中大多数病例是甲型流感 (7.8%) 和 RSV (5.9%)。26.0% 的 RADT 阳性患者和 33.9% 的 RADT 阴性患者使用了抗生素,调整后相对风险为 0.73(95% CI:0.54-0.99)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为,多重 RADT 结果阳性与抗生素处方略有减少和 抗病毒药物 使用增加相关,这表明多重 RADT 最好作为早期就诊者和高危患者的常规诊断,而不是作为减少总体抗生素消耗的一般策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现谨慎地表明,多重 RADT 可以通过减少 RSV 阳性成人不必要的抗生素处方来支持初级保健中的有针对性的抗菌药物管理,特别是在早期部署于可以从及时 抗病毒药物 治疗中受益的高危患者中时。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: RADT 的低到中等敏感性,特别是对于 RSV,限制了其作为通用排除工具的实用性,并且该研究的单季节、单区域设计限制了普遍性,需要进行适度的置信度评估。

papers.title: The L-type calcium channel Cav1.2 mediates influenza A virus infection by regulating viral internalization and endoplasmic reticulum homeostasis.
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) remains a major global health threat due to its high mutation rate and the emergence of antiviral resistance. Targeting host factors provides an alternative therapeutic strategy to overcome these challenges. Previous studies have shown that the L-type calcium channel Ca v 1.2 was implicated in viral infections. In this study, we aimed to clarify the mechanism by which Ca v 1.2 acts as a critical host factor mediating IAV infection, using the dihydropyridine-type calcium channel blocker nisoldipine. Nisoldipine showed notable antiviral activity in both in vitro and in vivo models. Mechanistically, nisoldipine inhibited IAV internalization by targeting Ca v 1.2, thereby suppressing calcium-dependent activation of the Ras-PI3K-AKT, RhoA-ROCK, and JNK pathways associated with viral internalization. Moreover, nisoldipine modulated the unfolded protein response (UPR) in host cells by promoting adaptive XBP1 splicing and contributed to the maintenance of endoplasmic reticulum (ER) homeostasis during IAV infection. Collectively, these observations support a sequential cascade model: Ca v 1.2 inhibition restrains viral entry and indirectly mitigates virus-triggered ER stress. Furthermore, nisoldipine exhibits broad-spectrum in vitro antiviral activity against multiple enveloped RNA and DNA viruses, including human coronavirus OC43 (HCoV-OC43), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Dengue virus Type 2 (DENV2), and Herpes Simplex Virus Type 1/2 (HSV-1/2). This study clarifies the mechanistic involvement of Ca v 1.2 in IAV infection and further identifies it as a promising broad-spectrum antiviral target with potential applications in preventing and treating influenza, human coronavirus infections, and other emerging viral diseases.

Collectively, these observations support a sequential cascade model: Ca v 1.2 inhibition restrains viral entry and indirectly mitigates virus-triggered ER stress. This study clarifies the mechanistic involvement of Ca v 1.2 in IAV infection and further identifies it as a promising broad-spectrum antiviral target with potential applications in preventing and treating influenza, human coronavirus infections, and other emerging viral diseases.

papers.title: The Effectiveness of Nirsevimab on Antibiotic Use in Children Using Target Trial Emulation.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Nirsevimab is a monoclonal antibody with demonstrated efficacy in preventing respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections in infants. Because acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs), including viral infections, often lead to antibiotic prescribing, we aimed to determine the effectiveness of nirsevimab on antibiotic prescribing among infants with medically attended ARTIs. METHODS: A primary care attendee cohort was established using electronic health record data from 32 diverse practices across a healthcare network to emulate a target trial comparing nirsevimab to no treatment among infants <8 months. Eligible infants were seen at a primary care practice within 14 days of life. Primary outcomes included time to first antibiotic prescription for (1) outpatient ARTIs, (2) outpatient encounters for bronchiolitis, and (3) RSV-related hospitalizations. Nirsevimab effectiveness was calculated as 1 minus the risk ratio for each primary outcome. RESULTS: Among 15 341 patients who met inclusion criteria, 7413 received nirsevimab. Compared with no treatment, nirsevimab administration led to a 14.4% (95% CI: 7.8%, 20.6%) reduction in antibiotic prescribing for outpatient ARTIs, a 40.3% (95% CI: 25.1%, 52.5%) reduction in antibiotic prescribing for outpatient bronchiolitis, and a 69.4% (95% CI: 4.8%, 90.1%) reduction in antibiotic prescribing for RSV-related hospitalizations. CONCLUSIONS: Nirsevimab administration in primary care reduced antibiotic use for ARTIs in both ambulatory and inpatient settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to determine the effectiveness of nirsevimab on antibiotic prescribing among infants with medically attended acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs). Using electronic health record data from 32 diverse primary care practices, the researchers emulated a target trial comparing nirsevimab to no treatment in infants under 8 months. The primary outcomes included antibiotic prescriptions for outpatient ARTIs, outpatient bronchiolitis, and RSV-related hospitalizations. Among 15,341 eligible infants, 7,413 received nirsevimab. The results showed a 14.4% reduction in antibiotic use for outpatient ARTIs, a 40.3% reduction for outpatient bronchiolitis, and a 69.4% reduction for RSV-related hospitalizations. The authors concluded that nirsevimab administration in primary care reduced antibiotic use for ARTIs in both ambulatory and inpatient settings. The study's observational design and reliance on electronic health records may introduce biases, limiting the confidence in the findings. These results could inform strategies to reduce unnecessary antibiotic use for RSV-related infections, contributing to public health efforts against antibiotic resistance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尼塞韦单抗 是一种单克隆抗体,已被证明可有效预防婴儿 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 感染。由于急性呼吸道感染 (ARTI),包括病毒感染,通常会导致开抗生素处方,因此我们旨在确定 尼塞韦单抗 对患有 ARTI 的婴儿开抗生素处方的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用来自医疗保健网络中 32 个不同诊所的电子健康记录数据建立了初级保健参与者 队列研究,以模拟一项目标试验,该试验在 8 个月以下的婴儿中比较 尼塞韦单抗 和无 治疗。符合条件的婴儿在出生后 14 天内到初级保健诊所就诊。
elements_zh.methods: 主要结局包括 (1) 门诊 ARTI 首次处方抗生素处方的时间,(2) 毛细支气管炎 门诊就诊情况,以及 (3) RSV 相关住院治疗。尼塞韦单抗 有效性的计算方法为 1 减去每个主要结局的风险比。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 15341 名符合纳入标准的患者中,7413 名患者接受了 尼塞韦单抗 治疗。与不使用 治疗 相比,尼塞韦单抗 给药导致门诊 ARTI 的抗生素处方减少 14.4%(95% CI:7.8%,20.6%),门诊 毛细支气管炎 的抗生素处方减少 40.3%(95% CI:25.1%,52.5%),以及 69.4% (95% CI: 4.8%,90.1%) RSV 相关住院抗生素处方减少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 初级保健中的 尼塞韦单抗 给药减少了门诊和住院环境中 ARTI 抗生素的使用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,尼塞韦单抗 可以减少 RSV 相关 ARTI 中不必要的抗生素使用,有可能减轻抗生素耐药性并改善婴儿的临床结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计基于电子健康记录数据,这可能会引入偏差和混杂因素。由于该研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

METHODS: A primary care attendee cohort was established using electronic health record data from 32 diverse practices across a healthcare network to emulate a target trial comparing nirsevimab to no treatment among infants <8 months. papers.title: Effectiveness of nirsevimab and maternal RSVpreF vaccination against infant hospitalisation across the island of Ireland.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: In 2024, two respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) immunisation strategies were introduced on the island of Ireland: nirsevimab in Republic of Ireland (ROI) and RSVpreF in Northern Ireland (NI). The primary objective was to estimate effectiveness against hospitalised RSV-associated acute lower respiratory infection (ALRI) in infants <6 months. The secondary objective was to compare impact on emergency department (ED) bronchiolitis attendances. METHODS: We conducted a multicentre, test-negative, case-control study across five sites during the 2024/25 season. Effectiveness against hospitalisation was estimated using multivariable logistic regression adjusting for age <3 months, sex, and prematurity. Infants born after 1 September 2024, hospitalised with ALRI, and tested for RSV were eligible. Time series modelling compared ED bronchiolitis attendances during the study season with five preceding seasons. RESULTS: 254 infants were included (ROI:165, NI: 89). In ROI, 34% of cases and 83% of controls received nirsevimab; in NI, 6% and 30% received RSVpreF respectively. Adjusted effectiveness against hospitalisation was 90.7% (95% CI 80.7-95.8) for nirsevimab and 83.9% (95% CI 41.5-96.6) for RSVpreF. Modelling showed significant reductions in ED bronchiolitis attendances; greater in ROI (52%) than NI (37%). CONCLUSIONS: Both interventions were highly effective against RSV-ALRI hospitalisation. However, coverage differed markedly, with important implications for population-level impact.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024/25 赛季期间,在五个地点进行了一项多中心、检测呈阴性的病例对照研究,其中包括 2024 年 9 月 1 日之后出生、因 ALRI 住院并接受 RSV 检测的婴儿。
elements_zh.methods: 使用多变量逻辑回归调整年龄 <3 个月、性别和早产来估计住院治疗的有效性。使用时间序列模型将研究季节期间 ED 毛细支气管炎 的出勤率与之前五个季节进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 纳入 254 名婴儿(ROI:165,NI:89)。尼塞韦单抗 的调整后住院有效性为 90.7% (95% CI 80.7-95.8),RSVpreF 的调整后有效性为 83.9% (95% CI 41.5-96.6)。模型显示 ED 毛细支气管炎 就诊人数显着减少;投资回报率 (52%) 高于 NI (37%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,这两种干预措施对于 RSV-ALRI 住院治疗都非常有效,覆盖范围存在显着差异,这对人口层面的影响具有重要意义。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为了解 RSV 疫苗 在减少婴儿 毛细支气管炎 住院和急诊就诊率方面的有效性提供了重要见解,这可以为公共卫生策略和 疫苗 的实施提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其仅抽象分析的设计而受到限制,并且由于可能存在混杂因素以及对观察数据的依赖,证据强度适中。

papers.title_zh: 尼塞韦单抗 和孕产妇 RSVpreF 疫苗接种 对爱尔兰岛婴儿住院治疗的有效性。
papers.source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: In 2024, two respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) immunisation strategies were introduced on the island of Ireland: nirsevimab in Republic of Ireland (ROI) and RSVpreF in Northern Ireland (NI). The primary objective was to estimate effectiveness against hospitalised RSV-associated acute lower respiratory infection (ALRI) in infants <6 months. The secondary objective was to compare impact on emergency department (ED) bronchiolitis attendances. METHODS: We conducted a multicentre, test-negative, case-control study across five sites during the 2024/25 season. Effectiveness against hospitalisation was estimated using multivariable logistic regression adjusting for age <3 months, sex, and prematurity. Infants born after 1 September 2024, hospitalised with ALRI, and tested for RSV were eligible. Time series modelling compared ED bronchiolitis attendances during the study season with five preceding seasons. RESULTS: 254 infants were included (ROI:165, NI: 89). In ROI, 34% of cases and 83% of controls received nirsevimab; in NI, 6% and 30% received RSVpreF respectively. Adjusted effectiveness against hospitalisation was 90.7% (95% CI 80.7-95.8) for nirsevimab and 83.9% (95% CI 41.5-96.6) for RSVpreF. Modelling showed significant reductions in ED bronchiolitis attendances; greater in ROI (52%) than NI (37%). CONCLUSIONS: Both interventions were highly effective against RSV-ALRI hospitalisation. However, coverage differed markedly, with important implications for population-level impact.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标:2024 年,爱尔兰岛引入了两种 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 免疫策略:爱尔兰共和国 (ROI) 的 尼塞韦单抗 和北爱尔兰 (NI) 的 RSVpreF。主要目的是评估 6 个月以下婴儿住院 RSV 相关急性下呼吸道感染 (ALRI) 的有效性。第二个目标是比较对急诊科 (ED) 毛细支气管炎 出勤率的影响。方法:我们在 2024/25 赛季期间在五个地点进行了一项多中心、测试阴性、病例对照研究。使用多变量逻辑回归调整年龄 <3 个月、性别和早产来估计住院治疗的有效性。2024 年 9 月 1 日后出生、因 ALRI 住院并接受 RSV 检测的婴儿符合资格。时间序列模型将研究季节期间 ED 毛细支气管炎 的出勤率与前五个季节进行了比较。结果:纳入 254 名婴儿(ROI:165,NI:89)。在 ROI 中,34% 的病例和 83% 的对照接受了 尼塞韦单抗;在北卡罗来纳州,分别有 6% 和 30% 的人接受了 RSVpreF。尼塞韦单抗 的调整后住院有效性为 90.7% (95% CI 80.7-95.8),RSVpreF 的调整后有效性为 83.9% (95% CI 41.5-96.6)。模型显示 ED 毛细支气管炎 就诊人数显着减少;投资回报率 (52%) 高于 NI (37%)。结论:两种干预措施对于 RSV-ALRI 住院治疗均非常有效。然而,覆盖范围存在显着差异,这对人口层面的影响具有重要意义。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,这两种干预措施对于 RSV-ALRI 住院治疗都非常有效,覆盖范围存在显着差异,这对人口层面的影响具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为了解 RSV 疫苗 在减少婴儿 毛细支气管炎 住院和急诊就诊率方面的有效性提供了重要见解,这可以为公共卫生策略和 疫苗 的实施提供信息。

papers.title: First- and Second-Year Outcomes After Nirsevimab Immunization.
papers.abstract: IMPORTANCE: The consistency of nirsevimab effectiveness across consecutive seasons and its broader clinical protective effects remain to be fully characterized. OBJECTIVE: To assess whether first-season effectiveness of nirsevimab against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)-lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI)-related hospitalizations is maintained during a new RSV season, whether the effectiveness persists beyond the first season, and whether nirsevimab exposure is associated with hospitalizations for non-RSV infections and asthma during the first and second years of follow-up. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study analyzed 2 nationwide matched cohorts using the French National Health Data System, including infants born in metropolitan France before the 2023 and 2024 immunization campaigns. Infants receiving nirsevimab were matched 1:1 to unimmunized infants. Both cohorts were followed up for 1 year after immunization, with an additional second year of follow-up for the 2023 cohort. Data analysis was performed from February 2023 to August 2025. EXPOSURES: Single dose of nirsevimab. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: RSV-LRTI-related, non-RSV infection, and asthma hospitalizations were assessed using weighted Cox proportional hazards models. RESULTS: This cohort study included 74 672 infants in 2023 and 175 526 in 2024. At baseline, the mean (SD) age of immunized infants was 4.5 (2.0) months in the 2023 cohort; 19 633 (52.6%) were male and 17 703 (47.4%) were female. The mean (SD) age of the 2024 cohort was 4.8 (2.2) months; 44 863 immunized infants (51.1%) were male and 42 900 (48.9%) were female. Among 37 366 infant pairs in 2023 and 87 763 pairs in 2024, RSV-LRTI-related hospitalizations during the first year of follow-up occurred in 299 (0.8%) immunized vs 899 (2.4%) unimmunized infants in 2023 and 456 (0.5%) vs 1711 (1.9%), respectively, in 2024. Nirsevimab was associated with a lower rate of RSV-LRTI-related hospitalization in both the 2023 and 2024 cohort during the first year of follow-up, with effectiveness estimates of 66% (95% CI, 61%-70%) and 72% (95% CI, 69%-75%), respectively. An association with higher rates of hospitalization for ear, nose, and throat (ENT) bacterial infections was observed (2023 cohort: weighted hazard ratio [wHR], 1.36; 95% CI, 1.00-1.84; 2024 cohort: wHR, 1.43; 95% CI, 1.15-1.78). No significant association was observed for other outcomes. During the second year of follow-up, no protective association was observed for RSV-LRTI-related hospitalization (wHR, 1.03; 95% CI, 0.73-1.43). An association with higher rates of hospitalization for ENT (wHR, 1.56; 95% CI, 1.10-2.22) and asthma (wHR, 1.24; 95% CI, 1.05-1.46) was observed. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This study found that nirsevimab was associated with a substantial reduction in RSV-LRTI-related hospitalizations during the first year across both the 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 seasons. It was not associated with reduced hospitalizations due to non-RSV infections or asthma, nor during the second year of follow-up.
